# Gcore CDN

> Configure Gcore CDN resources - origin groups, caching, SSL, purge, video delivery, and integrations with DNS, FastEdge, Grafana, and Terraform.

- [CDN](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn.md): Configure Gcore CDN resources - origin groups, caching, SSL, purge, video delivery, and integrations with DNS, FastEdge, Grafana, and Terraform.

## Getting Started

## Create a CDN resource
- [CDN resource overview](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/create-a-cdn-resource/overview.md): Create a standard CDN resource for websites or a video-streaming resource for HLS, DASH, or FLV, with a thirty-resource account limit.
- [Create a CDN resource](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/create-a-cdn-resource/create-a-cdn-resource.md): Create a CDN resource in the Customer Portal by selecting DNS management, configuring domains and origins, enabling WAAP, and activating delivery.
- [Create a CDN resource for video streaming](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/create-a-cdn-resource/create-a-cdn-resource-for-video-streaming.md): Create a CDN resource for video streaming with HLS, DASH, FLV, or MP4 formats, configuring geo-blocking, secure token authentication, custom domains, and origin shielding for global delivery without transcoding.

## Integrate CDN with CMS and other platforms
- [CMS and platform integrations](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms.md): Integrate Gcore CDN with CMS, ecommerce, forums, cloud storage, and infrastructure platforms including Cloudflare DNS.
- [Integrate CDN resource with AWS S3](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-aws-s3.md): Configure Gcore CDN resource with AWS S3 bucket as origin by creating S3 bucket, enabling Static Website Hosting, setting bucket policy, and using S3 Endpoint URL as CDN origin source with CNAME record.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with b2evolution](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-b2evolution.md): Configure b2evolution to serve static resources through a Gcore CDN custom domain by editing blogs conf advanced PHP on a stock install.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Cloudflare](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-cloudflare.md): Configure a Gcore CDN resource with Cloudflare DNS using a DNS-only CNAME and compatible origin protocol, host header, and SNI settings.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Concrete CMS](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-concrete5.md): Configure the Use CDN add-on in Concrete CMS 9.0.0 and later to serve static assets through a pull-based Gcore CDN resource.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Craft CMS](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-craft.md): Configure Craft CMS 5 asset delivery through Gcore CDN by mapping paths, setting the filesystem Base URL, attaching a volume, and verifying requests.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with CS-Cart](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-cs-cart.md): Configure CS-Cart static asset delivery through Gcore CDN by installing the Universal CDN add-on and setting its CDN URL.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Django CMS](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-django-cms.md): Configure Django CMS STATIC_URL and MEDIA_URL to serve static and media files through the Gcore CDN CNAME.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Drupal](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-drupal.md): Configure Drupal public file delivery through Gcore CDN by installing the CDN module, mapping an HTTPS domain, and verifying asset requests.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Google Cloud Storage](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-google-cloud-storage.md): Configure Google Cloud Storage as a Gcore CDN origin by publishing bucket objects, mapping paths, setting DNS, and verifying delivery.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with IPB](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-ipb.md): Configure IP.Board 3.2 to 3.4 CDN Settings to serve images, CSS, and JavaScript through a Gcore CDN custom domain.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Invision Community Classic 4.x](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-ips.md): Configure Invision Community Classic 4.x file delivery through Gcore CDN by assigning an HTTPS custom URL to supported storage configurations.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Joomla](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-joomla.md): Configure Joomla media delivery through Gcore CDN by installing Regular Labs CDN for Joomla Pro and assigning an HTTPS CDN domain.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Kirby](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-kirby.md): Configure Kirby media and assets URLs in index.php to serve static files through a Gcore CDN custom domain.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Magento](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-magento.md): Configure Magento Open Source and on-premises Adobe Commerce static and media delivery through Gcore CDN with secure base URLs.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Perch](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-perch.md): Configure Perch PERCH_RESPATH and eligible local bucket paths to serve resources through a Gcore CDN custom domain.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with PrestaShop](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-prestashop.md): Configure PrestaShop static asset delivery through Gcore CDN by assigning an HTTPS custom domain as the media server.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with PyroCMS 2.x](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-pyrocms.md): Configure PyroCMS 2.x Integration settings to serve static assets through a Gcore CDN custom domain.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with SocialEngine](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-socialengine.md): Configure SocialEngine static file delivery through Gcore CDN by assigning an HTTPS custom domain as the Static File Base URL.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with TYPO3](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-typo3.md): Configure TYPO3 static asset delivery through Gcore CDN with the Replacer extension and scoped TypoScript URL rules.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with vBulletin](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-vbulletin.md): Configure vBulletin 6 public static asset delivery through Gcore CDN by assigning an HTTPS CDN URL in server optimization settings.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with Webasyst](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-webasyst.md): Configure the Webasyst Site Settings CDN field to serve generated image, CSS, and JavaScript URLs through a Gcore CDN custom domain.

## Wordpress
- [Integrate a CDN resource with WordPress using the Gcore plugin](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/wordpress/integrate-cdn-resource-with-wordpress-gcore-plugin.md): Configure the Gcore CDN plugin for WordPress to rewrite selected static asset URLs through an HTTPS CDN domain and verify delivery.
- [Integrate CDN resource with WordPress (Rocket plugin)](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/wordpress/integrate-cdn-resource-with-wordpress-rocket-plugin.md): Configure Gcore CDN resource integration with WordPress using WP Rocket plugin by entering CNAME from Control Panel, updating Replace Site's Hostname field, and verifying static file URLs are rewritten to CDN CNAME domain.
- [Integrate CDN resource with WordPress (W3 Total Cache plugin)](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/wordpress/integrate-cdn-resource-with-wordpress-w3-total-cache-plugin.md): Configure Gcore CDN integration with WordPress using W3 Total Cache plugin by enabling Generic Mirror CDN type and entering your CDN CNAME in the hostname replacement field.
- [Integrate CDN resource with WordPress (WP SuperCache plugin)](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/wordpress/integrate-cdn-resource-with-wordpress-wp-supercache-plugin.md): Configure WP Super Cache plugin CDN integration by enabling CDN Support, entering Gcore CDN CNAME in Off-site URL field, and verifying static asset URLs are rewritten to the custom domain.
- [Integrate a CDN resource with X-Cart 4.4.x](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-x-cart.md): Configure X-Cart 4.4 file paths so skin, images, and cache assets load from a Gcore CDN custom domain.
- [Integrate CDN resource with XenForo](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-cms/integrate-cdn-resource-with-xenforo.md): Configure Gcore CDN resource integration with XenForo by editing config.php, updating Style General Settings with CDN CNAME domain, and verifying static file URLs are rewritten to the configured CNAME record.
- [Extend CDN functionality with FastEdge](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-fastedge.md): Integrate FastEdge CDN applications with a Gcore CDN resource to add custom request and response processing via Customer Portal or REST API.

## Configure an origin
- [Allow Gcore CDN access to an origin](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/configure-an-origin/add-cdn-servers-to-the-origin-acl-whitelist.md): Allow Gcore CDN edge servers to pull content from a restricted origin using request headers, public IP addresses, or public network ranges.
- [Configure HTTP/2 on the origin](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/configure-an-origin/configure-http-2-on-the-origin.md): Configure HTTP 2 over TLS or cleartext h2c on Nginx or Apache origins for clients and services that connect directly.
- [CDN timeouts](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/getting-started/cdn-timeouts.md): Review Gcore CDN Edge Network proxy timeout defaults and customize connection and read timeouts in the Customer Portal or via Support on Enterprise plans.
- [About CDN resources interface: how it is arranged](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/about-cdn-resources-interface-how-it-is-arranged.md): Create and manage CDN resources in the Gcore Customer Portal with filtering by status (Active, Suspended, Processing, Deleted), search by CNAME or resource ID, and per-resource operations including Settings, Statistics, Suspend resource, LIVE STREAMING preset, and Delete resource. Purge and Prefetch are accessible from the CDN navigation menu.
- [Add an origin group to a CDN resource](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/add-an-origin-group.md): Create and attach origin groups with URL, S3 storage, or FastEdge HTTP application origins and configure load balancing and failover.

## CDN resource options

## General
- [Specify an origin and the origin pull protocol](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/general/specify-an-origin-and-the-origin-pull-protocol.md): Configure CDN origin pull protocol (HTTP, HTTPS, or HTTP and HTTPS) and specify the origin group for content delivery.
- [Use a private bucket as an origin](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/general/use-a-private-bucket-as-an-origin.md): Create private S3 CDN origins in the Customer Portal or REST API, including Gcore Object Storage keys and credential rotation.
- [Enable origin SSL validation](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/general/enable-origin-ssl-validation.md): Enable origin SSL validation for CDN resources via the REST API using trusted CA and client certificates.
- [Set a custom domain for CDN](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/general/create-and-set-a-custom-domain-for-the-content-delivery-via-cdn.md): Configure custom and additional domains for CDN resources by entering domain names and creating CNAME records pointing to the assigned gcdn.co endpoint.
- [Enable and configure origin shielding](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/general/enable-and-configure-origin-shielding.md): Enable Gcore CDN origin shielding to route edge requests through a shield that caches content and fetches from origin on cache miss, reducing origin load.
- [Suspend a CDN resource automatically or manually](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/general/suspend-a-cdn-resource-automatically-or-manually.md): Manage CDN resource suspension - disable manually via the Content availability toggle or let the system auto-suspend after 90 days of inactivity.
- [Customize connection and read timeouts](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/general/customize-connection-and-read-timeouts.md): Configure custom connection and read timeouts for CDN resources to control how long edge nodes wait before returning a 504 Gateway Timeout error.

## Cache
- [Specify cache lifetime on a CDN resource or origin](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/cache/specify-cache-lifetime-on-a-cdn-resource-or-origin.md): Configure CDN cache lifetime with origin or CDN controlled settings, advanced caching rules, video TTL guidance, and cache header checks.
- [Set up a CDN resource to follow origin redirects](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/cache/set-up-a-cdn-resource-to-follow-origin-redirects.md): Enable CDN origin redirection to follow HTTP 3xx status codes (301, 302, 303, 307, 308) returned by the origin server via the Gcore Customer Portal or API.
- [Specify cache lifetime for user browsers](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/cache/specify-cache-lifetime-for-user-browsers.md): Configure browser cache lifetime on CDN resources via the Gcore Customer Portal using Origin controlled or CDN controlled modes.
- [Ignore the set cookie or query string parameters when caching content on CDN servers](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/cache/ignore-the-set-cookie-or-query-string-parameters-when-caching-content-on-cdn-servers.md): Configure query string caching modes (Ignore all, Ignore all except, Ignore only) and Set-Cookie caching behavior for CDN resources in the Customer Portal.
- [Always online: provide the stale cache if the origin is unavailable](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/cache/always-online-provide-the-stale-cache-if-the-origin-is-unavailable.md): Configure Always Online to serve stale cached content when the origin is unavailable via the Gcore Customer Portal.
- [Cache Sharding: share cache between CDN servers](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/cache/cache-sharding-share-cache-between-cdn-servers.md): Configure Cache Sharding to share cached content between CDN servers in the same PoP via consistent hashing, reducing origin load and improving cache hit rates.
- [Modify cache key](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/cache/modify-cache-key.md): Configure cache key variables (URI, protocol, normalized URI) in Gcore CDN resources via portal or API to control cache object identification and improve cache hit ratio.

## Access
- [Control access to the content with country, referrer, IP, and user agents policies](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/security/control-access-to-the-content-with-country-referrer-ip-and-user-agents-policies.md): Configure CDN resource access policies by country, referrer domain, and IP address ranges using allow or block rules in Resource settings via portal or API.
- [Set up a redirect from HTTP to HTTPS](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/security/set-up-a-redirect-from-http-to-https.md): Enable HTTP to HTTPS redirect on a CDN resource in the Customer Portal after HTTPS and an SSL certificate are active.

## Secure token
- [About secure token](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/security/use-a-secure-token/about-secure-token.md): Configure Gcore CDN Secure Token to protect content with time-based expiration and IP address restrictions, returning 410 Gone responses for expired tokens and unauthorized IP requests.
- [Configure and use secure token](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/security/use-a-secure-token/configure-and-use-secure-token.md): Configure secure token on a Gcore CDN resource to protect content with signed MD5 URLs and Unix expiration timestamps, using PHP, Python, or OpenSSL scripts.
- [Specify HTTP methods allowed for content requests from the CDN](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/security/specify-http-methods-allowed-for-content-requests-from-the-cdn.md): Configure allowed HTTP methods for a CDN resource via the Enable HTTP methods toggle to restrict accepted request types and return 405 for blocked methods.
- [Set the hostname passed in SNI requests to the origin](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/security/set-the-hostname-passed-in-sni-requests-to-the-origin-server.md): Configure Change SNI hostname on a CDN resource to control which hostname CDN servers include in TLS handshakes when pulling content from the origin over HTTPS.
- [Specify TLS versions allowed for content requests from the CDN](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/security/choose-tls-versions.md): Configure allowed TLS versions for a CDN resource to restrict which protocol versions end users can use for HTTPS connections to the domain.

## Security
- [Protect CDN resources with Gcore WAAP](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/cdn-security/protect-cdn-resources-with-waap.md): Enable WAAP (Web Application and API Protection) for CDN resources via the Customer Portal Security section to activate Layer 7 DDoS protection, web app security, and API protection; create CDN rules with WAAP exceptions to prevent blocking legitimate content by matching URLs or regex patterns.

## Compression
- [Configure Gzip and Brotli compression](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/compression/configure-gzip-and-brotli-compression.md): Configure Gzip and Brotli edge compression in CDN resource settings to compress content at edge nodes before delivery based on Accept-Encoding headers.
- [Configure fetch compression](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/compression/configure-fetch-compression.md): Configure Fetch compressed on a CDN resource to pull pre-compressed content from the origin, reducing bandwidth between origin and CDN edge servers.
- [Configuring HTTP status codes for CDN-hosted content](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/specify-custom-http-status-code-for-the-content-delivered-by-the-cdn.md): Configure custom HTTP status codes for Gcore CDN resources via Resource settings or Rules, with optional redirect URLs, status text, and time-based scheduling.
- [Optimize large file delivery](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/optimize-large-file-delivery.md): Enable Large File Delivery Optimization in Gcore CDN via Resource settings for files larger than 10 MB, using HTTP Range requests and 10 MB chunks.
- [Rewrite: redirect requests from the CDN to the origin](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/rewrite-redirect-requests-from-the-cdn-to-the-origin.md): Configure CDN Rewrite to rewrite request paths using nginx regular expressions, capture groups, and rewrite flags - break, last, redirect, permanent.
- [Allow permanent connections with the origin](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/websockets-allow-permanent-connections-with-the-origin.md): Enable or disable WebSocket support on CDN resources via the Gcore Customer Portal for persistent bidirectional connections between clients and origin servers.

## HTTP headers
- [Specify HTTP headers that CDN adds to requests to the origin](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/http-headers/specify-http-headers-that-cdn-adds-to-requests-to-the-origin.md): Configure HTTP request headers that Gcore CDN adds to origin requests via the Request Headers option, specifying header names and values with supported characters (letters, numbers, dashes, underscores, slashes, colons, equals, dots, spaces).
- [Add the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header to the browser response](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/http-headers/add-the-access-control-allow-origin-header-to-the-browser-response.md): Configure CORS headers in Gcore CDN via resource settings, rules, or origin server to allow cross-origin requests from specific domains or all origins.
- [Add or hide response headers](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/http-headers/add-or-hide-response-headers.md): Add or hide HTTP response headers in Gcore CDN - configure custom response headers per status code or hide origin headers via the Customer Portal.
- [Configure and check the host header](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/http-headers/configure-and-check-the-host-header.md): Configure the CDN Host header in resource settings using Custom Host header or Forward Host header, and verify the configured value with cURL.
- [Identify the client protocol with X-Forwarded-Proto](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/http-headers/use-the-x-forwarded-proto-header-to-identify-the-protocol-used-for-cdn-servers-requests.md): Identify HTTP or HTTPS client connections from the X-Forwarded-Proto header that Gcore CDN edge servers send to origins.
- [Network limits: set the content delivery speed to end users](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/network-limits-set-the-content-delivery-speed-to-end-users.md): Configure CDN download speed limit per connection using Static mode with a fixed rate and Limit after threshold, or Dynamic mode with query string arguments.

## Image optimization (paid)
- [About Image Stack](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/image-optimization-paid/about-image-stack.md): Configure Image Stack to optimize JPG and PNG images on the fly via quality adjustment, WebP and AVIF conversion, resize, and crop operations.
- [Enable Image Stack](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/image-optimization-paid/enable-image-stack.md): Enable Image Stack for CDN resources via Resource Settings or an Image optimization rule, and configure quality, compression, resize, and crop settings.

## Image stack tools
- [Configure image compression to WebP and AVIF](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/image-optimization-paid/image-stack-tools/configure-image-compression-to-webp-and-avif.md): Configure WebP and AVIF compression for CDN resources to convert JPG and PNG images automatically via Image optimization rules or query string parameters.
- [Change image quality](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/image-optimization-paid/image-stack-tools/change-image-quality.md): Configure image quality in CDN Image Stack via portal settings or the quality query parameter, applied alongside Compression, Resize, or Crop.
- [Crop images](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/image-optimization-paid/image-stack-tools/crop-images.md): Configure image cropping in Gcore CDN Image Stack using query parameters to specify aspect ratio, dimensions, and crop location.
- [Reduce image size](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/image-optimization-paid/image-stack-tools/reduce-image-size.md): Configure Resize query parameters to reduce JPG and PNG image dimensions on Gcore CDN, with automatic aspect ratio preservation, via the Image Stack feature.
- [Possible Image Stack errors](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/image-optimization-paid/possible-image-stack-errors.md): Troubleshoot Image Stack errors — examine status codes, response headers, and request methods using browser developer tools.
- [Query String Forwarding: forward parameters to sub-requests](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/query-string-forwarding.md): Configure Query String Forwarding in Gcore CDN to copy query string parameters from parent manifest requests to nested HLS and MPEG-DASH file requests, specifying forward_from_file_types, forward_to_file_types, and forward_only_keys via portal or API.

## Rules for particular files
- [Create a rule manually or from a template to configure settings for particular files](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/rules-for-particular-files/create-a-rule-manually-or-from-a-template-to-configure-settings-for-particular-files.md): Create CDN rules to override resource-level settings for specific file paths using URI patterns or regex, configuring cache lifetime, origin protocol, and other CDN options per rule with a maximum of five custom rules per resource.
- [Create a CDN resource rule template manually or use a system one](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/rules-for-particular-files/create-a-cdn-resource-rule-template-manually-or-use-a-system-one.md): Create CDN resource rule templates or apply system templates for video streaming, Let's Encrypt, static content, and image optimization via the Customer Portal.
- [Avoid indexing of your CDN resource by web crawlers](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/cdn-resource-options/rules-for-particular-files/set-robots-txt-to-avoid-adding-to-index-by-web-crawlers.md): Configure Status code rules on CDN custom domains to return HTTP 403 Forbidden responses and prevent web crawlers from indexing duplicate content across CDN and origin domains.
- [Clear CDN resource cache by URL, pattern, or all and check purge history](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/clear-cdn-resource-cache-by-url-pattern-or-all.md): Clear CDN resource cache by URL, pattern, or all using Gcore CDN Purge API or Customer Portal, with purge history tracking and rate limits of two requests per resource per minute.

## Grafana
- [View Edge Network statistics in Grafana](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/grafana/view-cdn-statistics-in-grafana.md): Install the Gcore Platform-EN Grafana plugin and visualize CDN, DNS, FastEdge, and WAAP statistics in dashboards.
- [CDN billing](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/how-the-cdn-service-and-its-additional-options-are-billed.md): View CDN billing details — monthly plan fees, traffic and request overage, credit limits, and service suspension behavior.

## IP configuration options
- [Bring Your Own IP](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/ip-configuration-options/byoip.md): Enable Bring Your Own IP for CDN to announce customer-owned IP prefixes from the Gcore ASN or a customer ASN.
- [Dedicated IP](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/ip-configuration-options/dedicated-ip.md): Enable a dedicated CDN IP address or subnet to isolate delivery from shared CDN IP space and reduce reputation risk.
- [Load content to the CDN before users request it](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/load-the-content-to-cdn-before-users-request-it.md): Enable CDN Prefetch to preload content into cache before user requests using file paths, supporting files 200 MB to 5 GB with maximum 100 paths per request and 1 request per minute limit.

## Logs
- [Logs uploader](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/logs/logs-uploader.md): Configure CDN Logs uploader to export request and cache behavior logs to Object Storage, S3-compatible, FTP, SFTP, or HTTP(S) destinations via Configurations, Policies, and Targets tabs with field selection, delivery frequency, and target authentication management.
- [Log viewer: view and download CDN resource logs](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/logs/log-viewer-view-and-download-cdn-resource-logs.md): View and download CDN resource logs using Log viewer with filters for time interval, client IP, HTTP method, status code, data center, and cache status; export up to 10,000 log entries per 24-hour period.

## SSL certificates
- [Add an SSL certificate to deliver content over HTTPS](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/ssl-certificates/add-an-ssl-certificate-to-deliver-content-over-https.md): Attach SSL certificates to CDN resources for HTTPS delivery using custom domains, supporting both third-party certificates and free Let's Encrypt certificates via Gcore Customer Portal.
- [Custom SSL certificate configuration](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/ssl-certificates/configure-your-own-ssl-certificate.md): Configure a custom SSL certificate in PEM format, attach it to CDN resources, then renew or delete certificates.
- [Configure Let's Encrypt certificate](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/ssl-certificates/configure-lets-encrypt-certificate.md): Enable HTTPS with free Let's Encrypt certificates on CDN resources using HTTP-01 or DNS-01 challenge validation, with optional Gcore Managed DNS delegation to ns1.gcorelabs.net and ns2.gcdn.services for domain ownership verification.

## Terraform
- [Manage CDN resources with Terraform v0](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/terraform/manage-cdn-via-terraform.md): Create and manage Gcore CDN resources using Terraform provider v0. Covers origin groups with host and S3 origins, CDN resources with delivery options, SSL certificates (automated and manual), CA certificates for origin verification, CDN rules, rule templates, presets, account configuration, origin shielding (premium), and CDN logs uploader (premium). Uses gcore_cdn_origingroup, gcore_cdn_resource, gcore_cdn_sslcert, gcore_cdn_cacert, gcore_cdn_rule, gcore_cdn_rule_template, gcore_cdn_applied_preset, gcore_cdn_client_config, gcore_cdn_originshielding, gcore_cdn_logs_uploader_policy, gcore_cdn_logs_uploader_target, gcore_cdn_logs_uploader_config resources.
- [Manage CDN with Terraform v2](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/terraform/manage-cdn-via-terraform-v2.md): Create and manage Gcore CDN resources using Terraform provider v2 - origin groups, CDN resources, SSL certificates, CA certificates, rules, and rule templates.

## Troubleshooting
- [Common Setup Issues](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/troubleshooting/common-setup-issues.md): Resolve CDN setup issues including 503 service unavailable errors from unreachable origins, ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS from HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect loops, incorrect MIME type headers causing file downloads, and Let's Encrypt SSL certificate validation failures due to DNS propagation delays.
- [Gcore CDN error status codes](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/troubleshooting/gcore-error-status-codes.md): Resolve selected Gcore CDN errors including 403, 404, 410, 402, 504, 508, 556, and 557 using Log viewer and resource settings.
- [Traceparent header for troubleshooting](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/troubleshooting/traceparent-header-for-troubleshooting.md): Use the W3C traceparent header on Gcore CDN to follow a request and share the value with Support.
- [Content is unavailable after a CDN resource creation: how to solve the issue](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/troubleshooting/content-is-unavailable-after-a-cdn-resource-creation-how-to-solve-the-issue.md): Troubleshoot CDN resource content unavailability by verifying origin HTTP 200 response codes, checking CNAME record configuration in DNS settings, and validating Host Header options in CDN resource settings.
- [Cache hit ratio is low: How to solve the issue](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/troubleshooting/cache-percentage-is-low-how-to-solve-the-issue.md): Monitor cache hit ratio in Gcore CDN Statistics to identify low cache delivery efficiency; check Cache-Control and Cache response headers on edge servers using X-id header tracking to diagnose origin requests and content delivery delays.
- [Content delivery speed is low: how to solve the issue](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/troubleshooting/content-delivery-speed-is-low-how-to-solve-the-issue.md): Diagnose and resolve low CDN content delivery speed by comparing origin and CDN performance using DevTools, wget, or online speed tests, then optimize CDN-resource settings including cache hit ratio, large file delivery, and gzip/brotli compression.
- [An SSL certificate isn't working: how to solve the issue](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/troubleshooting/an-ssl-certificate-isn-t-working-how-to-solve-to-issue.md): Troubleshoot CDN SSL certificate attachment errors, Let's Encrypt issuance failures, and browser TLS handshake errors including SSL_ERROR_INTERNAL_ERROR_ALERT.
- [3xx error: how to solve CDN issues with redirect](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/troubleshooting/3xx-error-how-to-solve-cdn-issues-with-redirect.md): Resolve CDN 3xx redirect errors by configuring origin pull protocol (HTTP or HTTPS) to match origin redirect settings, updating Host Header to match the origin domain, and setting the correct Origin source for redirected domains.
- [4xx error: how to solve CDN issues with the limited access and content non-existence](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/troubleshooting/4xx-error-how-to-solve-cdn-issues-with-the-limited-access-and-content-non-existence.md): Diagnose and resolve 4xx errors in Gcore CDN by verifying origin content availability, allowlisting CDN edge IPs, configuring Origin Pull Protocol, and validating Host Header settings; use Reports, Log viewer, and Raw logs to track error sources.
- [5xx error: how to solve server issues](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/troubleshooting/5xx-error-how-to-solve-server-issues.md): Diagnose and resolve HTTP 5xx errors on CDN edge servers and origin servers by checking Gcore Status Page for incidents, verifying origin availability and response times, whitelisting CDN edge server IPs in origin ACL, and configuring correct origin pull protocol and Host Header settings in CDN resource options.

## Video CDN
- [Video CDN Overview](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/video-cdn/video-cdn-overview.md): Configure Video CDN to deliver HLS, DASH, HTTP-FLV, and MP4 video streams through Gcore CDN edge locations worldwide; requires Support approval with Client ID, domain, content type, and licensing verification for live and VOD workflows.
- [Common Media Client Data (CMCD)](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/video-cdn/cmcd.md): Use Common Media Client Data (CMCD) with Gcore Video CDN to collect player-side playback and delivery metrics in query strings or request headers, improve CDN observability, and help Gcore Support investigate video playback issues.
- [HLS and LL-HLS via CDN](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/video-cdn/hls.md): Deploy HLS and LL-HLS video streams via Gcore CDN using HTTP-based adaptive streaming with master playlists, media playlists, fMP4 CMAF segments, and partial segments; configure cache rules, query parameter whitelisting, and LIVE STREAMING preset for low-latency delivery.
- [Improve video delivery speed for low-traffic accounts](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/video-cdn/improve-video-delivery-speed.md): Troubleshoot slow video delivery by checking CDN cache hits, origin 404s, live player requests, TTLs, Origin Shielding, and prefetch.
- [DASH and LL-DASH via CDN](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/video-cdn/dash.md): Deploy MPEG-DASH and LL-DASH (Low-Latency DASH) streams via Gcore CDN using .mpd manifests and CMAF segments with Chunked-Proxy technology to achieve 2-4 second glass-to-glass latency for live video delivery.
- [Multi-codec VOD delivery over CDN](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/video-cdn/multi-codec-vod-delivery.md): Deliver multi-codec VOD streams including HEVC, AV1, VP9, and H.264 renditions through Gcore CDN to reduce bandwidth consumption by 25-60% depending on codec choice and device compatibility.
- [Origin shielding for video delivery](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/video-cdn/origin-shielding-for-video.md): Enable origin shielding for video CDN delivery to add a precache shield server between origin and edge locations, reducing concurrent origin requests, origin egress costs, and improving reliability during live events and VOD cache misses.
- [Secure Token for Video CDN](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/video-cdn/secure-token.md): Enable Secure Token and Query String Forwarding in Video CDN to protect HLS and MPEG-DASH streams with temporary access tokens, forwarding token parameters from master manifests to nested manifests, segments, and subtitles via directory-path token rules.
- [Auto-refresh CDN secure tokens](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/video-cdn/secure-token-auto-refresh.md): Configure CDN Secure Token auto-refresh with 60-second expiration and query string parameters or path-based tokens to prevent link sharing during live streams and pay-per-view events, supporting plain or IP-bound token validation modes.
- [Troubleshoot video delivery](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/video-cdn/troubleshoot-video-delivery.md): Diagnose and fix common video delivery problems on CDN that end viewers experience
- [HTTP-FLV Live and VOD Delivery](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/video-cdn/flv-streaming.md): Deploy HTTP-FLV Live streaming with ultra-low latency (1-3 seconds) and high concurrency (100K+ simultaneous viewers) using Gcore CDN's dedicated FLV Live profile; configure origin to deliver FLV container with proper headers, monotonic PTS/DTS timestamps, H.264/H.265/AAC codecs, and HTTP 200 responses cached via sliding window RAM buffer.
- [View CDN reports and overview](https://docs.gcore.com/cdn/view-statistics-of-a-cdn-resource.md): Monitor CDN performance and traffic from Overview, Statistics, and Advanced Analytics reports in the Gcore Customer Portal.
